name: Batch processing (many fields)
description: Run a recipe of plugin steps over many fields with parallel workers, resume, per-field logs and a summary table; progress window.

params.name: fields-file
params.label: Fields list
params.help: Text file, one field per line: NAME path/to/image.fits

params.name: recipe-file
params.label: Recipe (JSON)
params.help: detect (ds9_sextract) or catalog, then steps of plugins that have a cli template. "Write Example Recipe" creates a starting point.

params.name: outdir
params.label: Output directory
params.help: Per field: catalog.tsv, state.json, field.log, work/; plus summary.tsv|json and status.json.

params.name: resume
params.label: Resume (skip steps whose inputs and parameters are unchanged)
